metadata.description: Ground truth dataset for evaluating the ROMI RAG CV-Matching system.  Covers retrieval accuracy, edge cases, cross-category confusion, hallucination detection, and ranking quality.

retrieval_accuracy.description: Does the system retrieve CVs from the correct professional category when given a specific job description?
retrieval_accuracy.how_to_evaluate: For each case, submit the 'query' to the /search endpoint and check whether the returned CV filenames / metadata belong to one of the 'expected_categories'.
retrieval_accuracy.metric: Precision@K — fraction of top-K results in expected category.

edge_cases.description: How does the system handle ambiguous, empty, off-domain, or malformed queries?
edge_cases.how_to_evaluate: Submit each query and verify the 'expected_behavior'. Record whether the system crashed, hallucinated, or gracefully handled the failure.
edge_cases.metric: Pass / Fail per case.  Document failure modes.

test_cases.query: developer
test_cases.description: Single-word query is highly ambiguous — could match React, Python, Java, SAP, SQL, ETL, or Dotnet developers. System should either return mixed results or flag low confidence.

test_cases.query: Looking for a quantum computing researcher with publications in topological qubits and experience with IBM Qiskit.
test_cases.description: Quantum computing is NOT a category in the dataset. The system should return low-relevance results or admit no strong match.
Empty query — the system should return an error or empty results, not hallucinate a job description.

test_cases.query: good person who works hard and is nice
test_cases.description: Personality-only query with no technical skills or domain. System has no meaningful signal to match against.

test_cases.query: Need a chef who is also a certified public accountant and has experience in aviation engineering.
test_cases.description: Contradictory multi-domain query. No single CV will match all three domains. System may retrieve random mix or hallucinate.

test_cases.query: مطلوب مهندس برمجيات لديه خبرة في تطوير تطبيقات الويب
test_cases.description: Arabic query ('Software engineer needed with web development experience'). The CV corpus is English-only so the embedding model may fail to bridge the language gap.
Special characters / garbage input — should be handled gracefully rather than crashing.

cross_category_confusion.description: Can the system distinguish between categories that share overlapping domain vocabulary?
cross_category_confusion.how_to_evaluate: Submit each query and check that the top-1 result belongs to 'expected_category', not any of the 'confusing_categories'.
cross_category_confusion.metric: Confusion-free rate — % of cases where top-1 is correct.

test_cases.query: Hiring an Electrical Engineer with experience in circuit design, power systems, and PLC programming.
test_cases.overlap_reason: Both are engineering fields sharing project management and CAD vocabulary.

test_cases.query: Need an ETL Developer experienced with SSIS, Informatica, data warehousing, and SQL Server.
test_cases.overlap_reason: ETL, SQL, and Database roles all share SQL and data pipeline terminology.

test_cases.query: Business Analyst needed — requirements gathering, stakeholder management, JIRA, and Agile methodology.
test_cases.overlap_reason: Business Analysts and Consultants share analysis and strategy vocabulary.

test_cases.query: Hiring a Graphic Designer proficient in Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, and brand identity design.
test_cases.overlap_reason: Design roles share creative-tool vocabulary (Adobe suite, UI/UX).

test_cases.query: Public Relations Specialist needed for media outreach, press releases, and corporate communications.
test_cases.overlap_reason: PR and Digital Media both deal with communications and media.

hallucination_detection.description: Does the LLM fabricate information not present in the retrieved context chunks?
hallucination_detection.how_to_evaluate: Feed the 'retrieved_context' as context_docs to the LLM evaluate_candidates prompt.  Manually verify every claim in the LLM output against the context using the 'checks' list.
hallucination_detection.metric: Hallucination rate — fraction of outputs containing fabricated facts.

ranking_quality.description: When multiple categories are partially relevant, does the system rank the most relevant one first?
ranking_quality.how_to_evaluate: Submit each query with top_n=10 and check whether the category distribution of results matches 'expected_ranking'.

test_cases.query: Full-stack developer with React front-end and Python Django back-end experience.

expected_ranking.reason: React is the primary skill mentioned.

test_cases.description: Query mentions both React and Python. Ideal retrieval should surface React CVs first, then Python, then generic web design.

test_cases.query: Data analyst with SQL expertise and experience building ETL pipelines.

expected_ranking.reason: Data analyst closest to data science.
SQL is a tool, not the core role.

test_cases.description: Overlapping skills across Data Science, ETL, and SQL categories. Ranking reveals retrieval precision.

test_cases.description: Tests whether the system correctly prefers the exact role category over broader management or engineering categories.
